metas.name: Samurai Rebellion
metas.description: Because you watched Harakiri: Kobayashi and Nakadai again, now with Mifune defying his clan in a slow-boiling revolt that ends in a superb duel.

metas.name: Yojimbo
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: Mifune plays two gangs against each other; the western's favourite source.

metas.name: Ninja Scroll
metas.description: Because you watched Berserk: feudal demon-ninja bloodshed, 90s OVA style.

metas.name: Sword of the Stranger
metas.description: Because you watched Demon Slayer: some of the finest sword-fight animation ever made.

metas.name: 13 Assassins
metas.description: Because you watched The Raid 2: Takashi Miike's epic battle finale is a masterclass in mayhem.

metas.name: Lady Snowblood
metas.description: Because you watched Riki-Oh: The Story of Ricky: snowy, blood-geysering revenge that Kill Bill borrowed wholesale.

metas.name: Lone Wolf and Cub: Sword of Vengeance
metas.description: Because you watched Riki-Oh: The Story of Ricky: disgraced executioner, baby cart, arterial spray.

metas.name: Ran
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: King Lear as a colour-drenched apocalypse.

metas.name: Throne of Blood
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: Macbeth in feudal fog, ending with Mifune under a hail of arrows.

metas.name: Seven Samurai
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: the template for every team-up movie; three and a half hours that fly.

metas.name: The Sword of Doom
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: Nakadai as a nihilist swordsman; the finale is pure carnage.

metas.name: The Twilight Samurai
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: Yoji Yamada's aching portrait of a low-rank samurai.

metas.name: Zatoichi
metas.description: Because you watched Shōgun: Takeshi Kitano's blind swordsman: deadpan, bloody, with a tap-dance finale.
